gates.name: Run Pester tests
gates.detail:
Invoke-Pester -Path tools -Output Detailed -PassThru — 22 files. Tests Passed: 401, Failed: 2, Skipped: 35, NotRun: 0. Total: 438. Both failures in tools/Invoke-CodexCommand.Tests.ps1:

[FAILED] Invoke-CodexCommand command map.has a mapping for every command file in .claude/commands/
Expected no exception to be thrown, because /track-local has no profile mapping, but an exception "No profile mapping for '/track-local'. Known commands: /brief-check, /design, /contract, /slices, /redteam, /slice, /reconcile, /make-human-docs, /track, /verify, /pr, /resolve, /fix, /refine, /install, /install-all, /kit-sync, /kit-help, /next, /clean, /install-code-review-agent, /freeze, /unfreeze. Pass --profile to codex directly for anything else." was thrown from tools/Invoke-CodexCommand.ps1:164 char:5

[FAILED] Invoke-CodexCommand tier stamping.stamps a tier for every command file in .claude/commands/
No profile mapping for '/track-local'. Known commands: /brief-check, /design, /contract, /slices, /redteam, /slice, /reconcile, /make-human-docs, /track, /verify, /pr, /resolve, /fix, /refine, /install, /install-all, /kit-sync, /kit-help, /next, /clean, /install-code-review-agent, /freeze, /unfreeze. Pass --profile to codex directly for anything else.

Root cause: both tests glob every *.md file directly under .claude/commands/ (Invoke-CodexCommand.Tests.ps1:16, Get-ChildItem '.claude/commands/*.md') and assert each one is an invokable Codex command with a profile mapping. That glob has never before matched a companion file, because this repository had none until this PR added .claude/commands/track-local.md (the accepted-gap fix for #305). The defect is pre-existing in Invoke-CodexCommand.ps1/.Tests.ps1 — neither excludes *-local.md companion files, which are never invoked directly as a slash command — and this PR is simply the first change to exercise it.
